# Got a severance offer? See if it is fair, what you net, and what to ask for.

> Free severance package calculator: compare your offer to the usual weeks per year of service, see your net as a lump sum now, a lump sum in January or salary continuation, the COBRA gap, unemployment at risk, your runway and what to ask for. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
